title: Vampire Bats Can Run on the Ground. Other Bats Failed the Test

scenes.text: A vampire bat sprints on the ground.
In 2005, Cornell scientists put bats on a treadmill.
The vampire bats ran, pushing off with their wings like front legs.
They topped out around two and a half miles an hour.
They can also leap into the air in about 30 milliseconds.
Out of about 1,100 bat species, they were the only ones that broke into a run in that test.

description:
In a 2005 Cornell study, vampire bats broke into a real run on a treadmill, pushing off with their wings.
They reached about two and a half miles an hour and can leap into the air in around 30 milliseconds.
Did you know bats could run?
first_comment: Which animal would you never expect to see running?
